name: @narada-core/mcp-loader-mcp
description: Policy-gated runtime MCP surface loader and proxy.

scripts.test:bun: pnpm --filter @narada-core/mcp-e2e-harness build && pnpm build && bun dist/test/protocol-smoke.test.js && bun dist/test/mcp-loader-mcp.test.js
scripts.test:node: pnpm --filter @narada-core/mcp-e2e-harness build && pnpm build && node dist/test/protocol-smoke.test.js && node dist/test/mcp-loader-mcp.test.js
scripts.test:native: pnpm run build:native && node --import tsx test/native-slice.test.ts && node --import tsx test/native-stateful-proxy.test.ts
